audience: Sales teams that write, send and track email sequences in Mixmax

useCases.title: Review sent and scheduled messages
useCases.text: List your messages, newest first, including drafts, scheduled, sent and failed emails. Open one message for its recipients and send state.

useCases.title: Track sequences and their recipients
useCases.text: List the sequences you can access. List the recipients of one sequence, with opens, clicks and replies per stage.

useCases.title: Find a template and read its body
useCases.text: List the email templates and template folders you can access. Open one template for its subject and body.

useCases.title: Review meeting invites
useCases.text: List the meeting invites you sent, including the meetings that are booked, with their times.

useCases.title: Create a draft email
useCases.text: Create a draft email. It is not sent: nobody receives it until someone sends or schedules the draft in Mixmax.

useCases.title: Add addresses to the unsubscribe list
useCases.text: Add addresses that asked to stop getting email. Sequences then stop sending to them.
